## DESeq GSE173955

### Loading Libraries and Data

```{r}
# Loading libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)

# Loading data
load(file='/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata')

isoform_counts_GSE173955 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE173955")

gene_counts_GSE173955 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(isoform_counts_GSE173955)
```

### Separating Metadata

```{r}

# Loading cleaned metadata
sample_metadata_GSE173955 <- read.csv(
  "data/metadata/GSE173955_metadata_clean.csv"
)

# Matching metadata order to gene counts
sample_metadata_GSE173955 <- sample_metadata_GSE173955[
  match(
    colnames(gene_counts_GSE173955),
    sample_metadata_GSE173955$sample_id
  ),
]

# Converting condition and sex into factors
sample_metadata_GSE173955 <- sample_metadata_GSE173955 |>
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Control", "AD")),
    sex = factor(sex)
  )

# Naming rows according to sample ID
rownames(sample_metadata_GSE173955) <- sample_metadata_GSE173955$sample_id

# Centering and scaling age for confounder adjustment
sample_metadata_GSE173955 <- sample_metadata_GSE173955 |>
  mutate(age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(age)))
```

### No Confounder Adjustment

Running DESeq

```{r}
# Creating DESeq dataset
dds_GSE173955 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = gene_counts_GSE173955,
  colData = sample_metadata_GSE173955,
  design = ~ condition
)

# Running differential expression analysis
dds_GSE173955 <- DESeq(dds_GSE173955)

# Extracting Alzheimer vs Control results
res_GSE173955 <- results(
  dds_GSE173955,
  contrast = c("condition", "AD", "Control"),
  alpha = 0.05
)

# Counting significant genes
n_sig_GSE173955 <- sum(
  res_GSE173955$padj < 0.05,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Counting upregulated genes
n_up_GSE173955 <- sum(
  res_GSE173955$padj < 0.05 &
  res_GSE173955$log2FoldChange > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Counting downregulated genes
n_down_GSE173955 <- sum(
  res_GSE173955$padj < 0.05 &
  res_GSE173955$log2FoldChange < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Displaying summary of results
cat(
  summary(res_GSE173955, alpha = 0.05),
  "\nNumber of Significant Genes:", n_sig_GSE173955,
  "\nNumber of Upregulated Genes:", n_up_GSE173955,
  "\nNumber of Downregulated Genes:", n_down_GSE173955,
  "\n"
)

```

Saving Results

```{r}
# Creating folder for results
out_dir_GSE173955 <- file.path("results", "DESeq2GSE173955")

dir.create(
  out_dir_GSE173955,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Converting results into a data frame
res_df_GSE173955 <- as.data.frame(res_GSE173955)

res_df_GSE173955$gene_id <- rownames(res_df_GSE173955)

# Saving all results
write.csv(
  res_df_GSE173955,
  file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "DESeq2_all_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Filtering for and saving significant genes
sig_genes_GSE173955 <- res_df_GSE173955 |>
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

write.csv(
  sig_genes_GSE173955,
  file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "DESeq2_significant_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

Dispersion Plot

```{r}
# Plotting dispersion estimates
plotDispEsts(dds_GSE173955)
```

MA Plot

```{r}
# Plotting mean expression against log2 fold change
plotMA(
  res_GSE173955,
  alpha = 0.05,
  main = "GSE173955 - Alzheimer vs Control"
)
```

Volcano Plot

```{r}
# Classifying genes by significance and fold change
volcano_GSE173955 <- as.data.frame(res_GSE173955) |>
  mutate(
    Regulation = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Upregulated",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Volcano Plot
ggplot(
  volcano_GSE173955,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj),
      color = Regulation)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Upregulated" = "forestgreen",
      "Downregulated" = "orange",
      "Not significant" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE173955 - Alzheimer vs Control",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-6, 6), ylim = c(0, 7)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Adjusting for Confounders

### Age and Sex

Running DESeq

